items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: They take the whole thing, go back so many times to (?0 and Isaiah, and I'm learning about the prophets.

ctx.x: That all goes in (?) in relation to discord, you see.

Right. Because I didn't know anything about the Bible until I got into Christian Science. And it makes you study... One thing, they study the whole Bible. They don't just study the New Testament or part of it. They take the whole thing, go back so many times to (?0 and Isaiah, and I'm learning about the prophets. You know, my son-in-law is a preacher. So he's been very helpful to me. Every time I'd run out there he'd get some books out -- I'd ask him about somebody. He's got all the different dictionaries and…
But we can get into that a little later.
